record.question: What is the primary significance of the 'Bio-RIDE' scheme recently approved by the Union Cabinet?
options: It merges existing biotechnology schemes into a single umbrella to promote 'Bio-manufacturing' and 'Bio-foundry'.
It provides subsidized electric bikes to researchers in biotechnology.
It mandates the use of 20% biodiesel in all public transport by 2025.
It focuses exclusively on the genetic mapping of endangered species in the Western Ghats.
